lines.text: Paul bows his knees before the Father, from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
Paul asks that out of the riches of His glory the Father strengthen them with power through the apostles.
Paul asks that Christ may dwell in their hearts through faith, as they are rooted and grounded in love.
Together with all the saints, they will have power to comprehend the length and width and height and depth of the kingdom of Christ.
God is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, and glory is His in the church and in Christ Jesus.
